title: Icacos Heritage & Recreation Tour
summary: A National Trust day trip combines Icacos history, an oil-making demonstration and coastal stops.
description: The National Trust of Trinidad and Tobago lists this full-day Icacos tour for Saturday, October 24, 2026, from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The itinerary includes an oil-making demonstration at the Coconut Oil Factory, Great Icacos Lagoon, Columbus Bay, Icacos Point and sea bathing at Coral Point. Tickets are TT$300 for non-members and TT$250 for members; optional lunch costs an additional TT$60. The organizer lists the tour as in stock; confirm transport and the meeting point before booking.
